description: This file defines the 'ThingQuerySignalMapper' class which extends 'AbstractQuerySignalMapper' and maps thing query signals to protocol-specific topic paths and payloads within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: ThingQuerySignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that extends 'AbstractQuerySignalMapper' to map 'ThingQueryCommand' signals to MQTT topics and payloads.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Returns the MQTT topic path builder for a given 'ThingQueryCommand' using its entity ID.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with selected fields from the 'ThingQueryCommand' if present.
